title: Flags carry source and date, and an unknown or failed load means off (row 4 match line, ours stricter)
reference_behaviour: Flags are fixed constants in code; what happens when they cannot be loaded is not known from the study.
ours: REQ-117 AC-2, AC-4, AC-5: each flag has a source and date, a missing, unknown or failed read is off, flags never loosen a gate. Kept as stricter safety, ADR-152 exception (a).
